admissionInfo.text: Completion of MATH 1210 Calculus I , MATH 1220 Calculus II , and MATH 2210 Calculus III with a 3.0 GPA. Completion of STAT 2040 Principles of Statistics with a grade of "B-" or higher. ENGL and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. GPA of 3.0 or higher with no grade lower than a C in content area courses. Completion of all General Education requirements and 70% of content area courses. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check.
